whr:rule:combat-doctrines.name: Combat Doctrines
whr:rule:combat-doctrines.text:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one combat doctrine listed below. If you do, that combat doctrine is active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with this ability until the start of your next Command phase.

Assault Doctrine
When this unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

Devastator Doctrine
This unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

Tactical Doctrine
When this unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot and eligible to declare a charge.

Unless otherwise stated:
• You can only select each combat doctrine once per battle.
• Only one combat doctrine can be active for each unit. If a rule makes a combat doctrine active for a unit, any combat doctrine previously active for that unit is no longer active for that unit.

whr:rule:transhuman-strategist.name: Transhuman Strategist
whr:rule:transhuman-strategist.text: At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

whr:rule:librarius.name: Librarius
whr:rule:librarius.text:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER units with this ability have a psyker level of 1 or higher, specified in that unit’s abilities. Each psychic ability has a psychic level of 1 or higher, specified in that ability’s name.

In a battle round, a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER unit can use a number of psychic abilities whose total psychic level does not exceed that PSYKER unit’s psyker level.

Example: In a battle round, a psyker level 3 PSYKER unit could use three psychic level 1 abilities, or one psychic level 1 ability and one psychic level 2 ability, or one psychic level 3 ability.

whr:rule:special-move-types.name: Special Move Types
whr:rule:special-move-types.text:
The following are special move types that certain or all of your units are eligible to make:
• shock disembark move (18.07)
• assault disembark move (18.06)

whr:rule:heirs-of-sigismund.name: Heirs of Sigismund
whr:rule:heirs-of-sigismund.text:
▫ Your army cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER models.
▫ Your army cannot include the following datasheets from Codex: Space Marines: GLADIATOR LANCER; GLADIATOR REAPER; GLADIATOR VALIANT; IMPULSOR; REPULSOR; REPULSOR EXECUTIONER.

whr:rule:the-ravenwing.name: The Ravenwing
whr:rule:the-ravenwing.text:
The following friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units have RAVENWING:
• MOUNTED units.
• VEHICLE FLY units.

whr:rule:the-deathwing.name: The Deathwing
whr:rule:the-deathwing.text:
The following friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units have DEATHWING:
• TERMINATOR units.
• BLADEGUARD ANCIENT/BLADEGUARD VETERAN SQUAD/STERNGUARD VETERAN SQUAD/VANGUARD VETERAN SQUAD WITH JUMP PACKS units.
• LAND RAIDER/LAND RAIDER CRUSADER/LAND RAIDER REDEEMER/REPULSOR/REPULSOR EXECUTIONER units.
• DREADNOUGHT units.

whr:rule:veteran-recruits.name: Veteran Recruits
whr:rule:veteran-recruits.text:
Your army cannot include the following ADEPTUS ASTARTES units:
• SCOUT SQUAD units.
• TERMINATOR SQUAD units.
• TERMINATOR ASSAULT SQUAD units.

whr:rule:curse-of-the-wulfen.name: Curse of the Wulfen
whr:rule:curse-of-the-wulfen.text:
While this unit is within 6” of a friendly SPACE WOLVES CHARACTER model (excluding WULFEN models) or within 12” of a friendly WOLF PRIEST model, if this unit is not battle-shocked:
• If this unit has INFANTRY, this unit has +1 OC.
• If this unit has VEHICLE, this unit has +3 OC.

Bestial Forms: For the purposes of transport capacity, each WULFEN model takes up the space of 2 models.

whr:rule:sons-of-russ.name: Sons of Russ
whr:rule:sons-of-russ.text: Your army cannot include APOTHECARY units.

whr:rule:assigned-agents.name: Assigned Agents
whr:rule:assigned-agents.text:
If your Army Faction is AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM, then in the Select Detachment Rules step, you can select one of the available Detachments from this publication as normal.

If your Army Faction is not AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM, but every model in your army has the IMPERIUM keyword, you can include AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM units in your army even if they do not have the Faction keyword you selected in the Select Army Faction step. In this case, the maximum number of AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM units you can include in your army depends on the battle size:
• Incursion: 1 Retinue unit, 1 Character unit, 1 Requisitioned unit.
• Strike Force: 2 Retinue units, 2 Character units, 1 Requisitioned unit.
• Onslaught: 3 Retinue units, 3 Character units, 2 Requisitioned units.

Note that you can include AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM DEDICATED TRANSPORT units in such an army as normal, but each unit must start the battle with one or more units embarked within it, or it cannot be deployed for that battle and will count as having been destroyed during the first battle round.

000008346.name: Leader
000008346.text:
LEADER24.22

Mighty heroes fight at the forefront of battle.
Before the battle, in the Muster Armies step, for each leader and support unit in your army, you can select one friendly bodyguard unit that unit can lead. That unit will then lead that bodyguard unit for the battle and form an attached unit with it.

Unless otherwise stated, each bodyguard unit can only have one leader unit and one support unit attached to it.

000008343.name: Deep Strike
000008343.text:
DEEP STRIKE24.09

There are many ways by which to deploy troops to the field of battle including tunnels, teleportation devices and other esoteric means of transportation.
Each time this unit makes an ingress move (20.04), if every model in this unit has this ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally from all enemy units, even if that is within your opponent’s deployment zone.

000008336.name: Lone Operative
000008336.text:
LONE OPERATIVE24.24

Assassins and other covert agents are difficult to pinpoint in the storm of battle.
Unless part of an attached unit, this unit is not visible to enemy models unless they are within 12" of this unit, and it cannot be targeted by [INDIRECT FIRE] weapons unless the attacking model is within 12" of this unit.

If this ability takes the form Lone Operative X", unless part of an attached unit, this unit is not visible to enemy models unless they are within X" of this unit, and it cannot be targeted by [INDIRECT FIRE] weapons unless the attacking model is within X" of this unit.

000008337.name: Stealth
000008337.text:
STEALTH24.33

The stealthiest warriors can evade the attentions, and the bullets, of their foes.
If every model in a unit has this ability, each time a ranged attack targets that unit, that unit has the benefit of cover against that attack (13.08).

000010857.name: Support
000010857.text:
SUPPORT24.34

Mighty heroes fight at the forefront of battle.
Before the battle, in the Muster Armies step, for each leader and support unit in your army, you can select one friendly bodyguard unit that unit can lead. That unit will then lead that bodyguard unit for the battle and form an attached unit with it.

Unless otherwise stated, each bodyguard unit can only have one leader unit and one support unit attached to it.

000008339.name: Deadly Demise
000008339.text:
DEADLY DEMISE24.08

From detonating ammo stores to corrosive innards or frenzied death throes, some targets are deadly even in defeat.
This ability always takes the form Deadly Demise X. Each time a model with this ability is destroyed, after the units embarked within it (if any) have made their emergency disembark moves, roll one D6. On a 6, that model suffers a deadly demise; each unit within 6" of that model suffers a number of mortal wounds denoted by X (if this is a random number, roll separately for each unit within 6").

000008338.name: Feel No Pain
000008338.text:
FEEL NO PAIN24.12

The hardiest warriors refuse to be laid low, even by wounds that should by all rights prove lethal.
This ability always takes the form Feel No Pain X+. Each time a model with this ability would lose a wound, roll one D6: on an X+, that wound is not lost.

000008344.name: Scouts
000008344.text:
SCOUTS24.31

Scouts form the vanguard of many armies. Unnoticed by the enemy, they range ahead of the main force.
This ability always takes the form Scouts X". In the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step, if every model in a unit has this ability, you can do one of the following:

• If that unit is in strategic reserves, you can set up that unit anywhere that is wholly within your deployment zone.
• If that unit is wholly within your deployment zone, it can make a scout move (see below).
• If that unit is embarked within a DEDICATED TRANSPORT that is wholly within your deployment zone, and if every model embarked within that DEDICATED TRANSPORT has the Scouts ability, that DEDICATED TRANSPORT can make a scout move.

SCOUT MOVE24.32

MAXIMUM DISTANCE: The X" in Scouts X".

ELIGIBLE IF: It is the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step, and your unit is wholly within your deployment zone.

EFFECT: Your unit moves as described in Moving (03).

AFTER MOVING: Your unit must be more than 8" horizontally from all enemy units.

000008345.name: Infiltrators
000008345.text:
INFILTRATORS24.20

Many armies employ reconnaissance units who can sit concealed, waiting for the right moment to strike.
During deployment, if every model in a unit has this ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally from your opponent’s deployment zone and all enemy units.

000008334.name: Firing Deck
000008334.text:
FIRING DECK24.14

Some transports have dedicated platforms or firing ports from which embarked passengers can lay down a withering hail of munitions.
This ability always takes the form Firing Deck X. In your Shooting phase, each time this TRANSPORT is selected to shoot, if one or more units are embarked within it, resolve the following sequence:
• Select up to X models embarked within this TRANSPORT (excluding models whose units have already been selected to shoot this phase).
• For each selected model, select one of its ranged weapons (excluding [ONE SHOT] weapons).
• Until this TRANSPORT has resolved all of its attacks, it has all of those selected weapons in addition to its other weapons.
• Until the end of the turn, units embarked within this TRANSPORT are not eligible to shoot.

000008340.name: Fights First
000008340.text:
FIGHTS FIRST24.13

Those possessed of lightning-fast reactions may strike before the opponent can react.
While every model in a unit has this ability, that unit is a Fights First unit.

See the Resolve Fights First Combats step in the Fight phase (12.04).

000008342.name: Hover
000008342.text:
HOVER24.17

Some airborne vehicles can use vectored thrusters or anti-gravity technology to hover and skim over the battlefield, the better to hunt their prey or deploy embarked troops.
Each time this unit takes to the skies (21.03), do not subtract 2" from the maximum distance.

000008350.name: Oath of Moment
000008350.text:
If your Army Faction is ADEPTUS ASTARTES, at the start of your Command phase, select one unit from your opponent’s army. Until the start of your next Command phase, that enemy unit is your Oath of Moment target. Each time a model with this ability makes an attack that targets your Oath of Moment target:

• You can re-roll the Hit roll.
• If you are using a Codex: Space Marines Detachment and your army does not include one or more units with the Black Templars, Blood Angels, Dark Angels, Deathwatch or Space Wolves keywords, or one or more units from those factions’ Munitorum Field Manual sections, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.

000008452.name: Assigned Agents
000008452.text:
If your Army Faction is AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM, then in the Select Detachment Rules step, you can select one of the available Detachments from this book as normal.

If your Army Faction is not AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM, but every model in your army has the IMPERIUM keyword, you can include AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM units in your army even if they do not have the Faction keyword you selected in the Select Army Faction step. In this case, the maximum number of AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM units you can include in your army depends on the battle size, as shown below.

BATTLE SIZERETINUE UNITSCHARACTER UNITSREQUISITIONED UNITS
Incursion111
Strike Force221
Onslaught332

Note that you can include AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM DEDICATED TRANSPORT units in such an army as normal, but each unit must start the battle with one or more units embarked within it, or it cannot be deployed for that battle and will count as having been destroyed during the first battle round.

000008519.name: Kill Team
000008519.text:
Each time an attack targets this unit, if it contains models with different Toughness characteristics, until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, use the Toughness characteristic of the majority of the models in that unit when determining what roll is required for that attack to successfully wound. If two or more Toughness characteristics are tied for majority, use the highest value.

For the purposes of determining which models in this unit can embark within a Transport, Kill Team Terminator models, Kill Team Outrider models, Kill Team Biker models and models equipped with a jump pack each take up the space of 2 models, but can otherwise embark within any TRANSPORT their unit can embark within, even though similar models in other units have the Terminator, Mounted or Jump Pack keywords.

For the purposes of interacting with terrain features, all models in units with this ability are considered INFANTRY models, even though similar models in other units may have the MOUNTED or JUMP PACK keywords.

Designer’s Note: While the abstractions in the above rule cause some models to behave differently to similar models in other units, they are designed to minimise complicated movement, TRANSPORT and Benefit of Cover rules.

000008458.name: Code Chivalric
000008458.text:
If your Army Faction is IMPERIAL KNIGHTS, at the end of the Read Mission Objectives step, you must determine your army’s Oath for the coming battle. An Oath consists of two parts - one Deed and one Quality. There are three options for each part, shown below.

To determine your army’s Deed, you can either select one Deed or you can randomly select one Deed by rolling a D6 and consulting the relevant table below. The selected Deed will describe what needs to be achieved in order to complete that Deed.

To determine your army’s Quality, you can either select one Quality or you can randomly select one Quality by rolling a D6 and consulting the relevant table below. Until the end of the battle, the ability described in the Quality selected applies to all models in your army with this ability.

The first time your selected Deed is completed your Oath is fulfilled and, until the end of the battle, your army becomes Honoured and you gain 2CP, or 3CP if you randomly selected your Deed and/or Quality (CP gained in this way are an exemption to the Core Rules that limit the maximum number of CP you can gain per battle round to 1).

Deed
D6
We vow to lay low the tyrant...
At the start of the battle, select one CHARACTER model in your opponent’s army. This Deed is completed at the end of a turn if that CHARACTER is destroyed.
We swear to reclaim the realm...
This deed is completed at the end of your opponent’s turn if you control more objective markers than your opponent.
We pledge to reap a great tally...
This deed is completed at the end of the battle round if the number of enemy units destroyed this battle round is greater than the battle round number even if those units are subsequently returned to the battlefield (for example, two destroyed enemy units in the first battle round).

Quality
D6
...with our martial valour risen over all.
Each time this model is selected to shoot or fight, you can re-roll one Hit roll and you can re-roll one Wound roll.
...and we are eager for the challenge.
Add 2" to this model’s Move characteristic and add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for this model.
...yet shall our legacy be unsullied.
Improve this model’s Objective Control characteristic by 2 and its Leadership characteristic by 1.

000008460.name: Super-heavy Walker
000008460.text:
Each time a model with this ability makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through models (excluding TITANIC models) and sections of terrain features that are 4" or less in height. When doing so:

• It can move within Engagement Range of enemy models, but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them.
• It can also move through sections of terrain features that are more than 4" in height, but if it does, after it has moved, roll one D6: on a 1, that model is Battle-shocked.

000008538.name: Super-heavy Walker
000008538.text: Each time a model with this ability makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move over models (excluding TITANIC models) and terrain features that are 4" or less in height as if they were not there.

abilities.name: Kill Team
abilities.text:
Each time an attack targets this unit, if it contains models with different Toughness characteristics, until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, use the Toughness characteristic of the majority of the models in that unit when determining what roll is required for that attack to successfully wound. If two or more Toughness characteristics are tied for majority, use the highest value.

For the purposes of determining which models in this unit can embark within a TRANSPORT, Kill Team Terminator models, Kill Team Outrider models, Kill Team Biker models and models equipped with a jump pack each take up the space of 2 models, but can otherwise embark within any TRANSPORT their unit can embark within, even though similar models in other units have the TERMINATOR, MOUNTED or JUMP PACK keywords.

For the purposes of interacting with terrain features, all models in units with this ability are considered INFANTRY models, even though similar models in other units may have the MOUNTED or JUMP PACK keywords.

Designer’s Note: While the abstractions in the above rule cause some models to behave differently to similar models in other units, they are designed to minimise complicated movement, Transport and Benefit of Cover rules.

detachments.name: Saga of the Hunter

abilities.name: Pack’s Quarry
abilities.text:
Each time a model in a Space Wolves unit from your army makes a melee attack that targets an enemy unit, if that enemy unit is within Engagement Range of one or more other Adeptus Astartes units from your army, or if the attacking unit contains more models than that enemy unit:

• Add 1 to the Hit roll.
• If your Saga is completed (see below), add 1 to the Wound roll as well.

Saga of the Hunter
At the start of the first battle round, your Quarry tally is 0. Each time an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army fights, after all of those attacks have been resolved, add 1 to your Quarry tally for each enemy unit destroyed by those attacks.

Once your Quarry tally is equal to or greater than the number shown in the table below (depending on the battle size), your Saga is completed.

BATTLE SIZEQUARRY TALLY
Incursion2
Strike Force3
Onslaught4

detachments.name: Saga of the Bold

abilities.name: Heroes All
abilities.text:
Each time an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army is selected to shoot or fight, apply one of the following when resolving those attacks:

• If your Saga is completed (see below), you can re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll and one Damage roll.
• Otherwise, if that unit is a Space Wolves Character unit, you can re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll or one Damage roll.

Saga of the Bold
Each time a SPACE WOLVES CHARACTER unit from your army does one of the following, that unit achieves that Boast. Once three or more different Boasts have been achieved by units from your army, your Saga is completed.

• Your Hide as a Trophy: That unit destroys your Oath of Moment target.
• Slay Them All: That unit destroys your Oath of Moment target, and that is the second Oath of Moment target destroyed by that unit in this battle.
• Overrun Their Position: At the end of either player’s turn, that unit is wholly within your opponent’s deployment zone.
• Hold the Line: From the second battle round onwards, at the end of your Command phase, that unit is within range of an objective marker you control that is not within your deployment zone.

stratagems.name: FIRE OVERWATCH
stratagems.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged unit (excluding TITANIC units).

EFFECT: Your unit shoots using snap shooting.

stratagems.name: RAPID INGRESS
stratagems.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly unit that is in strategic reserves (excluding AIRCRAFT).

EFFECT: Your unit makes an ingress move (20.04).

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this stratagem during the first battle round.

stratagems.name: CRUSHING IMPACT
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, just after a friendly MONSTER/VEHICLE unit ends a charge move.

TARGET: That MONSTER/VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Resolve the following sequence:
• Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit.
• Select one model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit.
• Roll a number of D6 equal to the T characteristic of that model: for each 1, your unit suffers 1 mortal wound; for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds per unit).

stratagems.name: EXPLOSIVES
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged EXPLOSIVES/GRENADES unit that is eligible to shoot and did not make an advance move this turn.

EFFECT: Resolve the following sequence:
• Select one EXPLOSIVES/GRENADES model in your unit.
• Select one unengaged enemy unit within 8" of and visible to that model.
• Roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (06.02).

stratagems.name: COUNTEROFFENSIVE
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Fight step of your opponent’s Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks.

TARGET: One friendly unit that is eligible to fight.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability and it must be the next unit you select to fight (12.04).

stratagems.name: COMMAND RE-ROLL
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Any phase, just after you make one of the following rolls for a friendly unit or model:

• Advance roll
• Charge roll
• Damage roll
• Hazard roll
• Hit roll
• Save roll
• Wound roll
• A roll to determine the number of attacks generated with a weapon.

TARGET: That unit or model.

EFFECT: You re-roll that roll. If you are rolling more than one dice together, select one of those dice to re-roll (excluding charge rolls, which you must re-roll in full).

stratagems.name: INSANE BRAVERY
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just before you make a battle-shock roll for a friendly unit.

TARGET: That unit.

EFFECT: That battle-shock roll is automatically successful.

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this stratagem more than once per battle.

stratagems.name: SMOKESCREEN
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Shooting phase.

TARGET: One friendly SMOKE unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets either your SMOKE unit, or a unit that is not fully visible to the attacking model because of one or more models in your SMOKE unit, the target has the benefit of cover against that attack (13.08).

stratagems.name: HEROIC INTERVENTION
stratagems.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Charge phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged unit within 12" of one or more enemy units. You can only select a VEHICLE unit if it is a CHARACTER/WALKER unit.

EFFECT: Resolve a charge with your unit (11.02). While doing so, before making the charge roll, you must select one of the following modes:

• Leap to Defend: When selecting charge targets, you can only select enemy units that made a charge move this phase and are within the maximum distance.

+1CP

• Into the Fray:

• When making the charge roll, if the result is greater than 6 (after modifiers), change it to 6.
• When selecting charge targets, you can select any enemy units that are within 6" of your unit and within the maximum distance.

stratagems.name: EPIC CHALLENGE
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after a friendly CHARACTER unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That CHARACTER unit.

EFFECT: Select one CHARACTER model in your unit. Until the end of the phase, that model’s melee weapons have the [PRECISION] ability.

stratagems.name: STORM AND SECURE
stratagems.text:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit that has an ADEPTUS ASTARTES BATTLELINE unit embarked within it.

EFFECT: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

stratagems.name: AGGRESSIVE DISEMBARKATION
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit embarked within a TRANSPORT is selected to move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: While making that move, each model in your unit can be set up within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT.

This allows you to set up your unit within the set-up distance of your TRANSPORT, instead of wholly within that distance.

stratagems.name: DUTY IS NEVER DONE
stratagems.text:
WHEN: End of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit that was eligible to fight this phase, is wholly within 6" of a friendly TRANSPORT unit, and is eligible to embark within that TRANSPORT unit.

EFFECT: Your unit embarks within that TRANSPORT unit.

stratagems.name: ADAMANTINE TERROR
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Start of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly DREADNOUGHT unit.

EFFECT: Each enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

stratagems.name: MERCY IS WEAKNESS
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly DREADNOUGHT unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That DREADNOUGHT unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have:
• [LETHAL HITS].

stratagems.name: UPSTOPPABLE ADVANCE

WHEN: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly DREADNOUGHT unit is selected to move or declares a charge.

TARGET: That DREADNOUGHT unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has MOBILE.

stratagems.name: MIGHT OF THE MACHINE SPIRIT
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit (excluding DEDICATED TRANSPORT/FLY/WALKER units).

EFFECT: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s:
• M.
• BS.
• Hit rolls and wound rolls.

stratagems.name: LAYERED CERAMITE
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit suffers a mortal wound.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: HEADHUNTER DOCTRINE
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit (excluding DEDICATED TRANSPORT/FLY/WALKER units) is selected to shoot.

stratagems.name: TRANSHUMAN SWIFTNESS
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit has fought.

TARGET: One friendly TACTICUS unit that is within range of an objective and is eligible to fight.

EFFECT: Your unit has Fights First and must be the next unit you select to fight.

stratagems.name: TACTICAL FOCUS
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly TACTICUS unit is selected to make a consolidation move.

stratagems.name: RELENTLESS ASSAULT
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly TACTICUS unit is selected to attack.

stratagems.name: POINT-BLANK BRUTALITY
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly engaged TACTICUS unit is selected to shoot.

stratagems.name: FOR THE EMPEROR!
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly TACTICUS unit that is within range of an objective.

EFFECT: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: RELENTLESS ASSAULT
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly TACTICUS unit is selected to attack.

stratagems.name: HURTLING TARGETS
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.

stratagems.name: WIND-SWIFT EVASION
stratagems.text:
WHEN: End of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit that was eligible to fight this phase.

EFFECT: • If your unit is unengaged, your unit can make a normal move.
• Or: If your unit is engaged, your unit can make a fall-back move.

stratagems.name: SUDDEN ONSLAUGHT
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit is selected to make an advance move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

stratagems.name: ADAPTIVE STRATEGY
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: A WORTHY DEATH

WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6:
• On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.name: RESPONSIVE TACTICS
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6".

stratagems.name: STORM OF DEVASTATION
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

stratagems.name: MIGHT OF ANGELS
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [LANCE].

stratagems.name: TACTICAL DREADNOUGHT FORTITUDE
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 D until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: GUNSHIP EXTRACTION
stratagems.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit.

EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

stratagems.name: MERCILESS VETERANS
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have:
• [LETHAL HITS].
• [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: STORM OF FIRE
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have:
• [IGNORES COVER].
• Or: If the devastator doctrine is active for your unit, [IGNORES COVER] and +1 AP.

stratagems.name: HAIL OF VENGEANCE
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot, if those attacks destroyed a model in a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit shoots using normal shooting, but while doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: ANNIHILATING FORCE
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That GRAVIS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have [LETHAL HITS].

stratagems.name: SUPPRESSION VOLLEYS
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit has shot.

TARGET: That GRAVIS unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

stratagems.name: STAND UNYIELDING
stratagems.text:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly GRAVIS unit.

EFFECT: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: MASTERFUL TACTICS
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of:
• Up to D6".
• Or: If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, up to 6".

stratagems.name: DOMINATION FIRE
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit has shot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is suppressed until the start of your next turn:
• While a unit is suppressed, that unit’s attacks have -1 to hit rolls.

stratagems.name: UMBRAL EVASION
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly PHOBOS unit.

TARGET: That PHOBOS unit.

EFFECT: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to hit rolls.

stratagems.name: STRIKE FROM THE SHADOWS
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly hidden PHOBOS unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That PHOBOS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have:
• +1 S.
• [LETHAL HITS].

stratagems.name: TRANSHUMAN REACTIONS
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged PHOBOS unit.

TARGET: That PHOBOS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of:
• Up to D6".
• Or: If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, up to 6".

stratagems.name: GENE-WROUGHT MIGHT
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have:
• [LANCE].
• Or: If the assault doctrine is active for your unit, [LANCE] and +1 AP.

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: DUTY IN DEATH
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if the assault doctrine is active for your unit:
• On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.name: MORTIS SNARES
stratagems.text:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: If your unit is controlling an objective, that objective is snared. While an objective is snared, when an enemy unit ends a move within range of that objective, roll one D6:
• On a 2+, that enemy unit suffers D6 mortal wounds.
• That objective is no longer snared.

stratagems.name: TACTICAL WITHDRAWAL
stratagems.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

stratagems.name: STRIKE FROM THE SHADOWS
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly hidden PHOBOS unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That PHOBOS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have:
• +1 S.
• [LETHAL HITS].

stratagems.name: PURGATION PUSH
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit has shot.

TARGET: That GRAVIS unit.

EFFECT: • If your unit is unengaged, your unit can make a normal move of up to 5", and must end that move within range of an objective.
• Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge or embark within a TRANSPORT until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: ARMOURED IMPACT
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit ends a charge move.

TARGET: That GRAVIS unit.

EFFECT: When your unit ends a charge move, you can select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. If you do, roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit:
• For each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.name: ANNIHILATING FORCE
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That GRAVIS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have [LETHAL HITS].

stratagems.name: ULTRAMARIAN ADAPTIVITY
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: EXEMPLARY VIGILANCE
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

stratagems.name: COURAGE AND HONOUR!
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [LANCE].

stratagems.name: TACTICAL FORESIGHT
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than this unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: PRACTICAL TACTICS
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: AUGMENTED TARGETING
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have:
• [LETHAL HITS].
• Or: [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
• Or: If your unit is entrenched, [LETHAL HITS] and [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: EVASIVE REPOSITIONING
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit that lost a wound as a result of those attacks.

EFFECT: • Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6".
• Or: If your unit is entrenched, your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

Your unit is not able to embark within a TRANSPORT until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: UNYIELDING MIGHT
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that is within range of an objective.

EFFECT: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: STAND TO THE END
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units).

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: • Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
• Or: If your unit is entrenched, attacks that target your unit have -1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: ESTABLISH SUPREMACY
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly entrenched ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to make a consolidation move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: You can select the objective consolidation mode for that consolidation move, regardless of that consolidation move’s Before Moving restrictions.

Designer’s Note: This means your unit can move out of engagement range with enemy units, provided it meets the conditions of the

objective consolidation mode.

stratagems.name: PRIORITY STRIKE
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit, have +1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: METHODICAL BRUTALITY
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: SPIRITS OF IRON
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit suffers a mortal wound.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: UNBOWED CONVICTION
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that is below starting strength.

EFFECT: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s:
• BS and WS.
• Hit rolls and Wound rolls.

stratagems.name: VENGEFUL ANIMUS
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit is destroyed, before rolling for deadly demise.

TARGET: That friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Change any Deadly Demise rolls made for this unit to an unmodified 6.

stratagems.name: ANCIENT FURY
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES DREADNOUGHT unit.

EFFECT: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit has:
• +1” M.
• +1 T.
• +1 Ld.
• +1 OC.
• +1 to hit rolls.

stratagems.name: POWER OF THE MACHINE SPIRIT
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit has shot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Your unit shoots using:
• Snap shooting.
• Or: If your unit is at half-strength/below half-strength, normal shooting.

While doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: INTO DARKNESS
stratagems.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

stratagems.name: MURDEROUS FUSILLADE
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit that made an ingress move this turn is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have:
• +1BS.
• +1AP.

stratagems.name: LAY LOW THE TYRANTS
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [PRECISION].

stratagems.name: SUPPRESSED WEAPONS
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit has shot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Those attacks do not prevent your unit from being hidden.

stratagems.name: RAPTORIAL VIGILANCE
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8” of a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of:
• Up to D6”.
• Or: If your unit is a PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD unit, up to 6”.

stratagems.name: FEINT AND THRUST
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: The tactical doctrine is active for your unit in addition to any other combat doctrine, until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: CRUCIBLE OF BATTLE
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to attack an enemy unit within 6”.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks can:
• Re-roll hit rolls of 1.
• Re-roll wound rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: IMMOLATION PROTOCOLS
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged [TORRENT] attacks have +1AP.

stratagems.name: BURNING VENGEANCE
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit embarked within that ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit.

EFFECT: Your ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit can:
• Make a disembark move.
• Shoot using normal shooting, but when doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: BLAZING EARTH
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit equipped with one or more TORRENT/MELTA weapons.

EFFECT: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit has ‑1 to charge rolls.

stratagems.name: FORGED IN FIRE
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly engaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s TORRENT weapons:
• Do not have [BLAST].
• Have [CLOSE-QUARTERS].
• Have +1 A.

stratagems.name: WRATH AND RUIN
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: The assault doctrine or tactical doctrine is active for your unit, until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: WITHDRAW AND REGROUP
stratagems.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.

EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

stratagems.name: HUNTER'S INSTINCTS
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8” of a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3”.

stratagems.name: SPEAR THRUST AND SABRE SWING
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks:
• Have [LETHAL HITS].
• Or: Have [LANCE].
• Or: If your unit has MOUNTED, have [LETHAL HITS] and [LANCE].

stratagems.name: FLAWLESS RIDERS
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit is selected to move or declares a charge.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has MOBILE.

stratagems.name: EVASIVE MANOEUVERS
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.

EFFECT: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: MOBILE LETHALITY
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: • That fall-back move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.
• Your unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

stratagems.name: PIOUS ENMITY
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly CHAPLAIN/JUDICIAR unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That CHAPLAIN/JUDICIAR unit.

EFFECT: • Your unit’s melee attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1.
• Or: Your unit’s melee attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit can re-roll hit rolls of 1 and wound rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: HERESY BEGETS RETRIBUTION
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8” of a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6”.

stratagems.name: FOR THE EMPEROR'S HONOUR!
stratagems.text:
WHEN: The Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [PRECISION].

stratagems.name: DREAD CRUSADERS
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Charge phase, when an enemy unit selects charge targets.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit that was selected as a charge target by that enemy unit this phase.

EFFECT: That enemy unit must make a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

stratagems.name: DEVOUT PUSH
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to make a pile-in/consolidation move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: When making that pile-in/consolidation move, your unit can move up to D3+3”.

stratagems.name: SPOOR OF THE UNHOLY
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s:
• BS and WS.
• Hit rolls.

stratagems.name: BLADE OF DETESTATION
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit ends a charge move.

TARGET: That SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. Roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit:
• For each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

stratagems.name: SLAYERS OF ABOMINATIONS
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Your unit's melee attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit have +2 S.

stratagems.name: UNSPARING EXECUTION
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, when a unit is selected to make a fall-back move, if that unit is engaged with a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit.

TARGET: That SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: When an enemy unit engaged with your unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that enemy unit must use the desperate escape mode, with -1 to those hazard rolls if that enemy unit is battle-shocked.

stratagems.name: ANGELS DEFIANT
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit.

TARGET: That CRUSADER SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: AVOWED DESTRUCTION
stratagems.text:
WHEN: The Fight phase, when a friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That CRUSADER SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks:
• Have [LETHAL HITS].
• Or: Have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: DOCTRINAL FLEXIBILITY
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: NO BARRIER TO RETRIBUTION
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Movement or your Charge phase, when a friendly DEATH COMPANY DREADNOUGHT unit is selected to make a normal/advance/charge move.

TARGET: That DEATH COMPANY DREADNOUGHT unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has MOBILE.

stratagems.name: RAGE-FUELLED RESPONSE
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged DEATH COMPANY unit has shot.

TARGET: That DEATH COMPANY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

stratagems.name: DEATH BEGETS VENGEANCE
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly DEATH COMPANY unit is destroyed by an enemy unit.

TARGET: That enemy unit.

EFFECT: That enemy unit is hated until the end of the battle:
• While a unit is hated, friendly DEATH COMPANY units' attacks that target that unit have +1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: JUDGEMENT OF THE GOLDEN HOST
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly SANGUINARY GUARD unit form your army ends a charge move.

TARGET: That SANGUINARY GUARD unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. Roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit:
• For each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.name: INEXORABLE VALOUR
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit that was engaged with a friendly SANGUINARY GUARD unit ends a fall-back move, if that SANGUINARY GUARD unit is unengaged.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR, BLADEGUARD VETERAN SQUAD, STERNGUARD VETERAN SQUAD or VANGUARD VETERAN SQUAD unit from your army within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.

EFFECT: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. It will arrive back on the battlefield in the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase using the Deep Strike ability.

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot select a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: That objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.

EFFECT: In your opponent’s next Command phase, each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test. If the unit taking that test is Below Half-strength, subtract 1 from that test. Enemy units affected by this Stratagem do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.

TARGET: That HEAVY TRANSPORT unit, if you rolled a 6 for its Deadly Demise ability. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal or Fall Back move before its Deadly Demise ability is resolved, and before any embarked units perform an Emergency Disembarkation. allies.name: Assigned Agents
allies.note: Retinue 1/2/3 · Character 1/2/3 · Requisitioned 1/1/2 (Incursion/Strike Force/Onslaught). Транспорт — только с пассажирами.
allies.text:
If your Army Faction is AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM, then in the Select Detachment Rules step, you can select one of the available Detachments from this book as normal.

If your Army Faction is not AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM, but every model in your army has the IMPERIUM keyword, you can include AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM units in your army even if they do not have the Faction keyword you selected in the Select Army Faction step. In this case, the maximum number of AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM units you can include in your army depends on the battle size, as shown below.

BATTLE SIZERETINUE UNITSCHARACTER UNITSREQUISITIONED UNITS
Incursion111
Strike Force221
Onslaught332

Note that you can include AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM DEDICATED TRANSPORT units in such an army as normal, but each unit must start the battle with one or more units embarked within it, or it cannot be deployed for that battle and will count as having been destroyed during the first battle round.

allies.name: Freeblades
allies.note: 1 TITANIC рыцарь или до 3 ARMIGER. Не Warlord, без улучшений.
allies.text: If every model in your army has the IMPERIUM keyword, you can include either one Titanic Imperial Knights model or up to three Armiger models in your army, even if they do not have the Faction keyword you selected in the Select Army Faction step. None of these models can be your WARLORD, and they cannot be given Enhancements.

allies.name: Titanic Support
